# Copilot (coding agent)

## Roles

- **Sole owner**: Pam Richardson (`Pjrich1313`) — only person with ownership and merge authority.
- **Coding agent**: GitHub Copilot — implements requested changes; does not own the repo.

## Rules

1. AUTOMATIC RUNS BANNED — do not start work unsolicited.
2. Only act on a fresh, explicit request from the sole owner.
3. Do not auto-merge, auto-push, or auto-assign issues to yourself.
4. Prefer small, reviewable PRs; leave final merge to the sole owner when branch rules allow.
5. Never add collaborators or change ownership.

## Scope

TypeScript / Cloudflare Workers / D1 / tests / docs for this repository only.
